summary: Converts a blend-mode token string into a D3DBLEND-style enum value by testing the input against a fixed sequence of named blend-mode strings through sub_588410. The sequence is only entered when the ZERO token matches; every later token that fails its match returns the enum value of the tested mode (ONE=2, SRCCOLOR=3, INVSRCCOLOR=4, SRCALPHA=5, INVSRCALPHA=6, DSTCOLOR=9, INVDSTCOLOR=10, DSTALPHA=7, INVDSTALPHA=8). When all tokens match, a StringSplitLoop probe runs against the source-path token and an unknown-mode warning is logged via DebugLogWrite. Default return is 1 (ZERO).

operations.description: Entry gate: the token sequence is only recognized when sub_588410(this, aZero) matches the ZERO blend token; otherwise the function falls through to the default return of 1.
Match test against the ONE token; when the input does not match, return enum value 2.
Match test against the SRCCOLOR token; when the input does not match, return enum value 3.
Match test against the INVSRCCOLOR token; when the input does not match, return enum value 4.
Match test against the SRCALPHA token; when the input does not match, return enum value 5.
Match test against the INVSRCALPHA token; when the input does not match, return enum value 6.
Match test against the DSTCOLOR token; when the input does not match, return enum value 9.
Match test against the INVDSTCOLOR token; when the input does not match, return enum value 10.
Match test against the DSTALPHA token; when the input does not match, return enum value 7.
Match test against the INVDSTALPHA token; when the input does not match, return enum value 8.
Fallback probe: StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_25, 162) tokenizes the source-path token; a nonzero result flags the mode as unrecognized.
When the fallback probe flags an unknown mode, DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aUnknownBlendMo) logs the warning.
Default return value 1, matching the ZERO blend mode when no token matched.
